s.note: Prawns tossed in garlic and chilli butter with stock and lemon
s.how: Melt 80g butter in a large pan until foaming. Add 6 sliced garlic cloves and a pinch of chilli flakes and cook 30 seconds. Add 600g peeled green prawns and toss over high heat for 2 minutes until just pink. Add 60ml chicken stock and the juice of 1 lemon and bubble for 30 seconds. Finish with chopped parsley. Serve straight away with crusty bread.

s.note: Egg and cress, and dill cream cheese with cucumber, crusts off, cut in fingers
s.how: Boil 4 eggs for 10 minutes, cool, then mash with 2 tbsp mayo and chopped cress. Spread 150g cream cheese mixed with dill on bread and layer with thin cucumber. Use 12 slices white bread, cut off the crusts and cut into fingers.

m.note: Lamb and carrot pie in Worcestershire gravy under baked buttery mash
m.how: Brown 750g lamb mince. Add 1 diced onion and 2 diced carrots, then 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and 250ml water. Simmer 40 minutes. Top with 1kg potatoes mashed with 60g butter and a splash of milk, then bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.note: Sponge layers with mascarpone cream, piled high with fresh strawberries
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 200g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Whip 250g mascarpone with 300ml cream and 2 tbsp sugar. Fill and cover the cake, then pile on 500g strawberries.

d.note: Black tea brewed in a warmed pot, milk and sugar on the side
d.how: Warm the teapot with hot water and tip it out. Add 4 tea bags and 1L freshly boiled water, then brew 4 minutes. Pour into four cups with milk in first or after, as you like, and sugar on the side.
